## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Skill-authored commits carry On-Behalf-Of and Correlation-Id trailers,...

The system SHALL ensure that skill-authored commits carry On-Behalf-Of and Correlation-Id trailers, verified by a test over a generated commit.

#### Scenario: Skill-authored commits carry On-Behalf-Of and Correlation-Id trailers,...

WHEN `attribution-trailers` is implemented
THEN Skill-authored commits carry On-Behalf-Of and Correlation-Id trailers, verified by a test over a generated commit.

### Requirement: Skill-created PR bodies include a metadata block with the principal chain...

The system SHALL ensure that skill-created PR bodies include a metadata block with the principal chain and correlation ID readable as plain markdown.

#### Scenario: Skill-created PR bodies include a metadata block with the principal chain...

WHEN `attribution-trailers` is implemented
THEN Skill-created PR bodies include a metadata block with the principal chain and correlation ID readable as plain markdown.

### Requirement: With the coordinator unavailable, trailers are still written using locally...

The system SHALL ensure that with the coordinator unavailable, trailers are still written using locally generated IDs.

#### Scenario: With the coordinator unavailable, trailers are still written using locally...

WHEN `attribution-trailers` is implemented
THEN With the coordinator unavailable, trailers are still written using locally generated IDs.
